title: AO/191/2008 of USMAAN ALI and ORS Vs SMT NAFEESHA BEGUM and ORS

paras.text:
AO No. 191/2008
Hon'ble B.C. Kandpal, J.
Mr. B.S. Parihar, learned counsel for
the appellants has stated before the Court
that the appellants want to withdraw this
appeal.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed
as withdrawn.
However, the appellants/claimants
are permitted to withdraw the money
deposed by the Insurance Company in
compliance of the impugned judgment and
award dated 4.2.2008, in order to deposit the
same in the fixed deposit, as has been
directed by the Tribunal concerned.
(B.C.K., J.)
Dated: 06.05.2008
ISB
